  • Constructor Details

    • NostrPrivateKey

      protected NostrPrivateKey(ByteBuffer data)
      Creates a new NostrPrivateKey from the given data.

      Note: This constructor directly stores the provided ByteBuffer as an internal reference. Modifying the ByteBuffer externally after passing it to this constructor may lead to unexpected behavior.

      If you don't want to worry about this, use one of the static factory methods such as fromBytes(byte[]) or fromHex(String) that copy the data.

      Parameters:
      data - the ByteBuffer containing the public key data

    • asReadOnlyBuffer

      public ByteBuffer asReadOnlyBuffer()
      Description copied from interface: NostrKey
      Returns an independent read-only view of the key's internal buffer.

      The returned view has its own position and limit. If the key is backed by direct memory, the view remains direct.

      Specified by:
      asReadOnlyBuffer in interface NostrKey

    • destroy

      public void destroy()
      Best-effort destruction of the in-memory private key material.

      Any mutable backing storage and cached byte array are overwritten. Cached textual encodings are released, but the JVM cannot guarantee immediate removal of immutable String copies or copies made by native cryptographic code.
